The '''Durillium Sea''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
The Durillium Sea was described as vast expanse of virtual nothingness. However, the quadrant was relatively safe for passing travelers and welcomed expansion. Nonetheless, the quadrant was inhabited by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and questions were raised regarding whether or not the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] would claim the area.

==Behind the scenes==
The Durillium Sea appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
